claims.text: The source defines IP-Adapter: frozen SD plus frozen OpenCLIP ViT-H/14 global image embedding projected to 4 tokens; decoupled cross-attention adds per-layer image K'/V' (initialised from text weights); only ~22M parameters trained with image-dropout for classifier-free-style control; reusable and ControlNet-compatible.
Reported numbers: COCO CLIP-I 0.828 / CLIP-T 0.588 vs SD-variations 0.760/0.548; 10M LAION+COYO pairs, 1M steps on 8xV100, DDIM-50 CFG-7.5.

limitations.text: Content/style resemblance only; not subject-consistent like DreamBooth/Textual Inversion.
